P.name: Perseverance
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Garen''' {{sti|health regeneration|link=true|regenerates}} an additional{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|1.5+0.2*(x-1) for 6;then + 0.8*x for 7; then + 0.4*x|formula=1.3%+0.2% per level up to level 6, then+0.8% up to level 13, then+0.4%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|(1.5+0.2*(x-1))/10 for 6;then + 0.8/10*x for 7; then + 0.4/10*x|formula=0.13%+0.02% per level up to level 6, then+0.08% up to level 13, then+0.04%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}
P.description2: ''Perseverance'' is lost for {{tt|8 seconds|Not a cooldown, unaffected by ability haste}} if '''Garen''' takes damage from {{tip|champion|champions}}, epic {{tip|monster|monsters}}, or {{tip|turret|turrets}}, or if he is hit by an enemy {{tip|ability}} or affected by an enemy [[summoner spell]], refreshing on subsequent damage and hits taken from them.

Q.name: Decisive Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself of all {{tip|slow|slows}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|35% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a duration.
Q.description2: Additionally, '''Garen''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|4.5}} seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, {{tip|lunge}} at the target, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, and {{tip|silence}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
Q.description3: ''Decisive Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Garen's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Courage
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever '''Garen''' kills an enemy, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Courage'', stacking up to 150 times.
W.description2: {{sbc|Courage:}} For each stack, '''Garen''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|{{fd|0.2}} '''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|{{fd|0.2}} '''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, up to a maximum of 30 '''bonus''' resistances each.
W.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' reduces incoming damage for 4 seconds. For the first {{fd|0.75}} seconds, '''Garen''' additionally grants himself a {{tip|shield}} and 60% {{tip|tenacity}}.

E.name: Judgment
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' rapidly spins his sword around himself 7 (+ 1 per {{tt|{{as|25% '''bonus''' attack speed}}|Only bonus attack speed from item stats and growth (per level)}}) times over 3 seconds, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks but gaining {{tip|ghosting}} and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies {{tt|periodically|Spin rate is 3 ÷ number of spins}}. ''Judgment'' can be recast after 1 second while active, and does so automatically after it ends.
E.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40 to 52}}% AD)}}|Critical Strike Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*(1+0.3) to 16*(1+0.3)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*(1+0.3) to 52*(1+0.3)}}% AD)}}|{{ii|Infinity Edge|IE}} Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+0.3) to 16*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+0.3)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+0.3) to 52*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+0.3)}}% AD)}}}}
E.description2: Enemy champions hit 6 times by ''Judgment'' are inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|25% armor reduction}}}} for 6 seconds, with the duration refreshing upon the 7th hit and every 6th hit thereafter.
E.description3: ''Judgment'' deals {{ap|(1.25-1)*100}}% increased damage against the nearest enemy hit.
E.description5: ''Judgment'' can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{#expr:100+0.3*100}}|{{#expr:0.3*100}}}}|critical damage}} damage.|{{sti|{{as|{{#expr:0.3*100}}% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}

R.name: Demacian Justice
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' calls upon the might of ''Demacia'' onto the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing them {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} as well as {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for 1 second at the start of the cast time.
R.leveling: {{st|True Damage|{{ap|125 to 275}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25 to 35}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
